messages.content: The Cambria confirmation is wrong. It has me checking out Wednesday, January 14, but my flight is Thursday afternoon and I have the inspection Thursday morning. Please extend the same reservation by one night.

I found the mismatch on confirmation CNO-418672. The issued reservation covers January 11-14, three nights, despite the earlier itinerary showing a Thursday checkout. The same room type is still available for Wednesday night at the quoted terms. I can request the extension to Thursday, January 15, before the January 7 payment date.
Do that. Keep it as one reservation, and don't accept a higher nightly rate without checking with me.

The hotel can add January 14-15 to the existing booking at the same room rate. The additional night is $196.46 including tax, bringing the complete four-night total to $785.85. The payment and cancellation terms remain unchanged: full payment January 7, with free cancellation through 11:59 p.m. Central time January 6.
Please complete it and make sure the luggage-storage note is still attached.

The extension is being applied to confirmation CNO-418672 as a single continuous stay. I am also retaining the note for complimentary storage of the exhibition case and roller bag after Thursday checkout, with pickup expected by 1:15 p.m.
I need the corrected dates in the final confirmation, not just a note on the account.

The corrected confirmation has been issued for Cambria Hotel New Orleans Downtown: check-in Sunday, January 11; checkout Thursday, January 15; four nights; one adult. The complete total is $785.85 including taxes, with no destination fee. Confirmation CNO-418672 remains the same. Full payment is scheduled for January 7, and cancellation is free through 11:59 p.m. Central time January 6. The Thursday storage note remains attached for the exhibition case and roller bag, with pickup by 1:15 p.m.
